last_amend_reason: tickets.json NOTES field only, 1 ticket (T-347), no verify field touched. Sharpening a ticket minted 20 minutes ago with two facts from a repo-wide sweep of its own class, both independently verified here before writing. (1) A TIGHTER GRAIN THAN THE TICKET STATED: reservation_key in apps/exchange/src/auction/state.py is referenced by EXACTLY ONE test in the entire repository and it is the docker-marked one - test_t158_acceptance_claim.py lines 904 and 907, inside test_the_redis_store_reserves_atomically_across_independent_instances, which carries @pytest.mark.docker at line 875. Confirmed by grep across every test_*.py, which returns that single file. So the defect is worse than minted: not only does reserve ATOMICITY have one conditional detector, the KEY DERIVATION the atomicity depends on has NO unconditional coverage whatsoever. The recommended closure now says to assert the key reserved UNDER, not merely that one SET .. NX is issued, which covers reservation_key at no extra cost. (2) A SYMBOL-LEVEL CONTRADICTION RECORDED SO IT DOES NOT READ AS A REFUTATION: at the symbol level reserve is NOT only-conditionally covered - 1 conditional and 4 unconditional tests reference that name. That CONFIRMS rather than weakens the ticket, because the unconditional four exercise a DIFFERENT IMPLEMENTATION of the same method name, the file-backed stand-in, not the Redis one the deployment runs. An auditor with a symbol-level tool will see "5 tests cover reserve" and conclude the ticket is wrong; they will be counting a name, not a code path. Writing that into the ticket is cheaper than having someone re-derive it and close it wrongly. CLASS CONTEXT so the severity is not over-read: 53 production symbols in this repo are exercised only by environment-conditional tests, and essentially all the others are Neo4j- or Postgres-backed code in services/ingest/src/graph/ and apps/trust/src/ledger/ where docker-only coverage is INHERENT, since the behaviour under test IS the datastore. T-347 is the only member of the class that is not inherent and the only money-path one. Verified with the formatting-immune structural comparison rather than a line grep: zero tickets added, zero removed, fields changed = notes on T-347 only.
